outcome: Frequency of eczema-related nocturnal sleep disturbance
finding: Eczema symptoms are common among adolescents in Kuwait, with similar epidemiological patterns as those observed in western countries, and a large proportion of affected adolescents reported nocturnal sleep disturbance due to itchy rash.
mod_finding: Cesarean section delivery was associated with frequent (≥1 nights per week) nocturnal sleep disturbance due to itchy rash (aPR = 1.98, 95% CI: 1.37-2.85).
